column1: # The one GitHub App allowed to write "verified-run" commit statuses (#3418).
# NOT secret: these are public ids. The private key is never in git; it goes in
# Empty on purpose: no recorder App exists yet, so //tools/pipeline/verifiedrun
# refuses to record. It must be an App that only the recorder uses, with the
# "Commit statuses: write" permission and nothing else it does not need. It must
# NOT be an agent app: those open the PRs, and a record has to come from
# someone other than the PR's author. Creating it is James's call.
# The later PR check trusts a status only if its creator is bot_user_id.
